items.description: Rayong is a city on the east coast of the Gulf of Thailand and the capital of Rayong province. It covers tambons Tha Pradu and Pak Nam and parts of tambons Choeng Noen and Noen Phra, all within Mueang Rayong district. As of 2016 the population was 64,256.

items.markdown:
Rayong is `a coastal province and city in eastern Thailand known for Koh Samet, fresh seafood, and quiet beaches` . Located about a 2.5 to 3-hour drive south of Bangkok, it offers an authentic local feel compared to neighboring busy tourist hubs.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rayong) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rayong)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rayong_province)[[3]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Rayong/465)[[4]](https://iamkohchang.com/blog/rayong-expat-guide.html)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8THppsXw0cI&t=18)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qG7LTnZP9EI)

Top Attractions

- **Koh Samet:** Famous island featuring white sand beaches like Hat Sai Kaew and quiet coves like Hat Praow.
- **Rayong Botanical Garden:** Wetlands area featuring kayaking, cycling routes, and a rare paperbark (Melaleuca) ancient forest.
- **Khao Laem Ya–Mu Ko Samet National Park:** Scenic coastal headland with sweeping ocean views and walking trails.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Rayong/465) [[1]](https://www.hashcorner.com/en/travel/thailand/rayong/rayong/)[[2]](https://www.takemetour.com/amazing-thailand-go-local/things-to-do-in-rayong-thailand/)[[3]](https://www.hashcorner.com/en/travel/thailand/rayong/rayong/)[[4]](https://nestopa.com/th-en/articles/explore-the-natural-wonders-of-rayong)

Food and Culture

- **Seafood & Markets:** Ban Phe market is famous for local products like shrimp paste, dried squid, and fish sauce, while local spots serve exceptionally fresh catches by the shore.
- **Fruit Festival:** Held annually in May to celebrate the region's rich tropical fruit harvest like durian and mangosteen.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tl86GT_5n44&t=50) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tl86GT_5n44&t=50)[[2]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Rayong/465)
